thread:
julia: Heads up — CI job `eval-runner-quant` on PR #3282 is failing in the qa pipeline. Dashboard shows a bunch of NaN scores and the trace uploader logs contain truncated artifact uploads. https://ci.internal/reports/3282

sam: yep I saw that. quick grep in the runner logs shows repeated 'connection reset by peer' during trace upload and then a small object (4KB) landed in S3. looks like the uploader is cutting the stream early.

carla: ran the job locally with --debug. runner emits gzipped jsonl and calls our multipart uploader but the stream is closed before the final boundary when a quantized model outputs large token traces. suspect an interaction between streaming gzip flush and multipart chunking. snippet:

```
2026-03-20T17:04:12Z uploader INFO chunk=0 size=4096
2026-03-20T17:04:12Z uploader ERROR write failed: broken pipe
2026-03-20T17:04:12Z runner ERROR trace flush aborted, samples=120
```

tara: that matches a repro here. reproducer: run eval-runner with --model=llama-q4_0 and prompt=long-tests. The backend sees smaller part uploads (<5MB) then aborts. The ingestion service then rejects the object because trace.metadata.schema_version is present but per_sample array incomplete.

infra-bot: upload error summary: 7 failed uploads in last 10m for bucket redwood-eval-traces-qa; first failure at 17:03:02 UTC. Alert: trace_ingest_failures > 5/min.

sam: two issues we should address: (1) uploader prematurely closes stream for gzipped output when using our chunked-writer + compression, (2) ingestion should validate and surface schema mismatches (currently it just returns 200 and metrics become NaN).

carla: quick plan — I'm going to: 1) add a flush/finalize call after gzip writer close in runner uploader (small PR), 2) add a local unit test that streams a large gzipped JSONL and asserts multipart parts >1 are created and completed. will target PR today.

julia: thanks. for the dashboard NaNs we should gate CI so a trace ingest failure fails the eval job (right now ingest errors are swallowed). tara, can you add an assert in the qa pipeline?

tara: yes. I'll add a mandatory post-upload validation step that calls /ingest/validate and fails the job if status != ok. Also adding a schema check to CI that asserts trace.metadata contains sample_id and prompt_tokens. PR I'll open: #3290.

sam: also adding defensive change in the ingestion service — if a trace's samples array length doesn't match declared sample_count, return 4xx and log a clear error message to the pipeline. I'll own that PR (#3291).

carla: quick note — this only reproduces with quantized models because they emit larger per-step debug outputs in our current eval harness. We should consider truncating debug fields for CI runs (keep them for nightly full-trace jobs). Proposing a runner flag `--ci-sanitize-traces` that strips heavy fields.

julia: agreed. default CI run should be strict and small. add the flag and set it in qa config. Also add a size guard: fail if any per-sample payload > 1MB.

infra-bot: temporary mitigation applied: CI job eval-runner-quant on qa now uses fallback model llama-q8_0 until uploader fix lands.

carla: PR #3288 opened: uploader flush + unit tests. relnote: fix for gz flush causing early EOF on multipart uploads. ripgrep shows two spots where Close() wasn't followed by writer.Flush() — fixed.

sam: thanks. I added a small validation library to the runner (sha256 checksum in trace metadata) so ingestion can verify object integrity. will push tests after review.

julia: plan of record: carla ships #3288 hotfix, sam lands checksum + runner validation, tara adds CI assert + schema test (#3290), sam updates ingestion to 4xx on mismatch (#3291). owners: carla, sam, tara. target: hotfix in next 3 hours, full pipeline gating by EOD.

carla: starting canary deploy of uploader fix to qa now, will run the failing job and paste logs here.

ci-bot: Build 3288.1 started for eval-runner-quant (canary).

carla: canary run passed — multipart parts: [6, 3], final object size 18,412,332 bytes, no truncated writes. trace metadata includes checksum.

julia: awesome. I pushed a dashboard alert to the eval console to break when >1 ingest failure in 15m and to tag the failing run with the PR number.

sam: I'll follow up with a postmortem blurb for the eng-ml postmortems channel once all PRs are merged. includes recommended CI defaults for quant runs and schema migration notes.

julia: thanks all. :raised_hands: If anything regresses, ping me and we'll escalate to SRE.

tara: adding follow-up tasks: add end-to-end test in nightly that runs quant model with full traces and verifies ingestion + report generation. moving to backlog and tagging owners. :white_check_mark:

carla: will close the tracker once #3288/#3290/#3291 are merged and the QA job reverts to quant model.

sam: ack.

julia: ack.
